sources.title: Passports and visas abroad
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: The Danish Foreign Ministry's live passport-and-visa guidance defines this product's scope as Danish citizens travelling on a Danish national passport for tourism.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Informationerne på vores pas- og visumsider gælder for danske statsborgere, der rejser på dansk nationalitetspas og med turisme som det primære formål.

sources.title: Republic of the Congo passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: The Danish Foreign Ministry's current Republic of the Congo page says the destination authorities supplied the Danish-citizen rules and directly places the application at the Congo-Brazzaville embassy in France; it was updated 5 June 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visumpligt. Visum kan søges via Congo-Brazzavilles ambassade i Frankrig.

sources.title: Central African Republic passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Danish Foreign Ministry page confirms a visa is required but expressly says it has no further Danish entry-rule information, so it does not establish timing or an issuance channel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vi har ikke yderligere oplysninger om visumregler for danskeres indrejse.

sources.title: Liberia - Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The live lis.gov.lr service identifies the Liberia Immigration Service as the authority implementing the Alien and Nationality Law. It makes its arrival route depend on whether a Liberian embassy is in the traveller's country, not nationality alone.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Iran passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Danish Foreign Ministry Iran page names online, embassy and airport issuance variants for Danish citizens and was updated 4 June 2026; it does not select one unconditional ordinary-passport issuance outcome.
sources.supportingExcerpt: prisen afhænger af om det er udstedt online, på ambassaden eller i lufthavnen ved ankomst

sources.title: Iraq passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Danish Foreign Ministry Iraq page says Iraqi authorities have not supplied Danish-citizen rules and expressly distinguishes federal Iraq from the Kurdistan Region; links to portals do not establish Danish eligibility or issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Indrejsekravene varierer delvist mellem det føderale Irak og Kurdistan-regionen (KRI).

sources.title: Virgin Islands Laws Online: related Immigration and Passport legislation
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Government laws register identifies a 2026 Immigration and Passport Visa Exemption Order, but the accessible register entry does not directly classify a Danish ordinary passport or state issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Immigration and Passport Visa Exemption Order, 2026

sources.title: Palestine passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: The Danish Foreign Ministry's current Palestine page says Palestinian authorities do not issue visitor visas and Israel controls entry and exit in most places; it expressly distinguishes combined Israel-Palestine trips from West Bank-only travel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ind- og udrejse af Palæstina kontrolleres langt de fleste steder af Israel.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Republic of the Congo advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Danish Foreign Ministry guidance requires ordinary Danish tourist visitors to obtain a visa through the Congo-Brazzaville embassy in France before travel.
conditions: Use a Danish national passport for tourism and apply through the Congo-Brazzaville embassy in France before travel.
The stated six-month passport validity, document-recognition, carrier and final-admission requirements remain applicable.
Work, residence, transit, refugee/alien and emergency or special-passport arrangements are outside this classification.

application.label: Danish Foreign Ministry Republic of the Congo visa guidance
steps: Confirm the current visitor requirements with the Congo-Brazzaville embassy in France.
Apply for the visitor visa through that embassy before travel.
Travel with the issued visa and the required valid Danish national passport and health documentation.

unresolved.reason: Available Danish Afghanistan visitor guidance is on a legacy path and only gives a generic visa requirement. No current official primary source establishes a usable ordinary Danish short-visitor issuance route amid Afghanistan's restrictions.

Denmark's current page gives an embassy application channel, but no current official source establishes a usable ordinary Danish short-visitor route despite DPRK permission, border, sponsor and operational constraints.

The available Denmark-specific visa rule is stale and current official Burkina Faso material reviewed does not directly map a Danish ordinary passport to an electronic or mission-issued visitor route. A portal is not treated as eligibility proof.
Current Danish guidance confirms a visa requirement but expressly has no further Danish entry-rule information. It does not establish a visitor issuance channel or timing.
The available Danish Comoros page is legacy-dated and no current official source directly establishes ordinary Danish short-visitor eligibility and actual issuance timing.

Liberia's current arrival service depends on whether a Liberian embassy is in the traveller's country. No current official source directly establishes a nationality-wide ordinary Danish visitor route, so a country-of-application condition is not inferred from Danish nationality.
The available Denmark-specific Mali rule is legacy-dated and no current official Malian source directly establishes ordinary Danish visitor eligibility and issuance timing.
The available Denmark-specific Niger rule is legacy-dated and no current official Nigerien source directly establishes ordinary Danish visitor eligibility and issuance timing.

No current British Virgin Islands or Danish primary source directly classifies an ordinary Danish passport. The 2026 BVI exemption-order register is not treated as a nationality schedule by omission, and UK rules are not transferred.

Current Danish guidance lists online, embassy and airport issuance variants but does not determine which applies to one ordinary Danish tourist baseline. An online application is not normalized as an eVisa.

Current Danish guidance says Iraqi authorities did not supply Danish-citizen rules and distinguishes federal Iraq from the Kurdistan Region. Its portal links do not establish Danish eligibility or actual issuance timing for one baseline.

Palestinian authorities do not issue visitor visas and Israel controls most entry and exit. Combined Israel-Palestine travel and West Bank-only travel have different rules, so no single Palestine-wide Danish visitor status is normalized.

The available Danish Syria page is dated 2024, says Syrian authorities have not supplied Danish rules and only names an online application. It does not establish current ordinary Danish eligibility or electronic issuance.
